sloka: स्व पक्ष वर्धनम् कुर्वन् महद् ऐश्वर्यम् अश्नुते ॥हीयमानेन कर्तव्यो राज्ना सम्धिः समेन च ॥६-३५-९॥।।
transliteration: sva pakṣa vardhanam kurvan mahad aiśvaryam aśnute ॥hīyamānena kartavyo rājnā samdhiḥ samena ca ॥6-35-9॥।।

translations.english: "When a king is losing strength, he should join hand s with the enemy who is equal to him. He should not disrespect the enemy but quit his hostility and join him (if the enemy is more powerful)."
